title: Configure project rewards and an oracle baseline
description: You compare expected net rewards using the example's hidden success probabilities.

steps.description: You define five projects with true success probabilities, rewards per success, and attempt costs. The comments distinguish hidden probabilities from known rewards and costs.
You supply prior successes and failures as pseudo-counts. The configured horizon contains 2000 funding rounds.

steps.question: Does the oracle select the largest success probability alone?
steps.answer: It maximizes p_true*R-C, the expected net reward. The reward and cost arrays affect the choice alongside success probability.

steps.description: You select and print the largest expected net reward as the oracle baseline. The recording identifies P4 with expected reward 9.0.
